name: Gahmuret

attributes.attribute: was father of the knight Percival
rescued Belkane from two armies and married her
bore Gahmuret a son named Feirefiz
became Percival's mother after Gahmuret returned to Wales

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Gahmuret was an Arthurian hero and the father of the knight Percival. He joined the army of the Caliph of Baghdad. There he rescued the besieged queen Belkane of Zazamanc, acting on his own against two armies. Belkane married him and bore a son named Feirefiz. No realm kept the warrior home. He returned to Wales, where he won the fair Herzeloyde, who became Percival's mother.

okr.objective: Record Gahmuret as the father of Percival.
key_results: Describe Gahmuret serving the Caliph of Baghdad and rescuing Belkane.
Name Feirefiz, the son of Gahmuret and Belkane.
Relate Gahmuret's return to Wales and his son Percival through Herzeloyde.
